steps.title: Prepare the console
lines: Fully power off the console and flip it upside down.
Remove the game card, headphones, charging cable, stylus, and anything else connected.

steps.title: Loosen the back cover screws
lines: Use a JIS 0 screwdriver to loosen the two black captive screws on the back cover.
The screws are held in place by captive washers and shouldn't be completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the back cover
lines: Pry off the back cover and remove it.
Insert an opening tool or the flat end of a spudger into the small notch above the battery and pry the battery out.
